title.full: What the Enhanced Retirement Sum means

summary.text: The ERS is the most you can top up your Retirement Account to. In 2026, it is $440,800.

details.heading: The amount changes yearly
details.body: The ERS increases every 1 January. It is not based on your age or the year you turned 55.

details.heading: Why top up
details.body: You can top up your Retirement Account with cash or Ordinary Account savings. A top-up can give you higher monthly payouts in retirement.

example_phrasings: What is the Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS)?
How much can I top up to my Retirement Account?

sources.page_title: What is the Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS)?

quotes.text: The Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS) in 2026 is $440,800. This is the maximum amount that members aged 55 and above can top up their Retirement Accounts (RA) to in 2026.
The ERS amount is not dependent on your age or the year you turn 55 years old. It increases yearly on 1 January.
You can top up your RA with cash or your Ordinary Account (OA) savings. Topping up your RA allows you to receive higher monthly payouts in retirement.
